Tooltip

A short piece of contextual text that appears on hover or focus, next to an element. Four placements and an optional link — hover a trigger below to see it live.

2 variants4 placements2 widthsToken-driven

Preview

Hover the button to see the tooltip appear.
Title The number of individuals or development machines working on all projects using an Iron Product. Per-seat licensing Counts unique developers, not machines. Learn more The number of individuals or development machines working on all projects using an Iron Product. Organisation seats Counts unique developers, not machines. Learn more

Variants

Two Property 1 variants — Default is title + body; With link adds a "Learn more" action for tooltips that point to more detail. Toggle Show Title off on Default for a compact, title-less tooltip.

Placement

Four placements, chosen by available space around the trigger. Toggle exactly one Show arrow-* property per instance. The dashed box marks the trigger element's boundary the tooltip is anchored to.
Title Tooltip above the trigger.
TopShow arrow-bottom
Title Tooltip below the trigger.
BottomShow arrow-top
Title Tooltip to the right.
RightShow arrow-left
Title Tooltip to the left.
LeftShow arrow-right

Sizes

Default width is 200px for short copy. Switch to the wide (350px) variant when the body text needs more room. It sets width, not max-width — which is why the prop is wide and not maxWidth.
Default Short copy fits in 200px. Wide Use the 350px wide variant when the message needs a full sentence or two to stay readable — like this one.
SizeWidthUse for
Default200pxShort labels, single short sentence
Wide350pxLonger explanations, two short sentences

Code

Copy-and-own — HTML markup, or the token-bound CSS. Show exactly one .tt-arrow per instance.
<span class="tt show-on-hover">
  <!-- a11y: trigger points at the bubble; bubble is role="tooltip" -->
  <button class="tt-trigger" aria-describedby="tip-1">Hover me</button>
  <span id="tip-1" role="tooltip" class="tt-bubble above">
    <span class="tt-arrow arrow-bottom"></span>
    <!-- .tt-content holds the rounded, filled box; keeps the arrow un-clipped -->
    <span class="tt-content">
      <!-- omit .tt-title entirely for a compact, title-less tooltip -->
      <span class="tt-title">Title</span>
      <span class="tt-body">Supplementary detail here.</span>
      <!-- optional -->
      <a class="tt-link" href="#">Learn more <span class="tt-link-icon"><svg>…</svg></span></a>
    </span>
  </span>
</span>
.tt-bubble {   /* positions the arrow + content; no fill of its own */
  position: absolute; width: var(--tt-w);   /* .wide => var(--tt-w-max) */
}
.tt-content {   /* the visible rounded box — separate so overflow:hidden */
  background: var(--tt-bg);               /* doesn't clip the arrow poking out of .tt-bubble */
  border-radius: var(--tt-radius);
  box-shadow: var(--tt-shadow);
  overflow: hidden;                      /* clips title's square corners to match */
}
.tt-title {   /* darker header bar — neutral/950, own fill */
  padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--tt-title); background: var(--tt-title-bg);
}
.tt-body  { padding: 12px 16px 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tt-body); }   /* no own fill */
.tt-link  { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tt-link); }
.tt-link:hover { color: var(--tt-link-hover); }   /* blue → pink, same as Button outline/ghost */
.tt-arrow.arrow-bottom {   /* tooltip above trigger; direct child of .tt-bubble, not .tt-content */
  width: 8.4853px; height: 8.4853px;       /* 12 / √2 — the visible half spans 12 */
  background: var(--tt-arrow);
  bottom: -4.2426px; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
  border-bottom-right-radius: 2px;       /* the 2px is why Figma's depth is 5.17, not 6 */
}

Do & Don't

✓ Do
  • Use tooltips to surface supplementary, non-critical information.
  • Keep tooltip text concise — one to two short sentences maximum.
  • Position the tooltip close to its trigger element.
✗ Don't
  • Don't place critical or required information inside a tooltip — it may never be seen.
  • Don't use long paragraphs or multiple lines of dense text.
  • Don't rely on tooltips for mobile interactions where hover is unavailable.
